HEADER: Init +5; Senses Low light vision; Perception +8
DEFENSE: AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 armor, +3 Dex, +1 natural armor)
Defensive Abilities Feathers of Gale, Well-Versed; Resist Wind 5;
OFFENSE: Special Abilities Bardic Performance (13 rounds/day), Countersong, Distraction, Fascinate (DC 15), Inspire Courage +1, Inspire Competence +2, Inspire Greatness, Inspiration (2d6) [6/day], Troubadour (3/day)
At will (DC 13) - songbird, song of serenity
1st (DC 14) - adoration, elemental carol, elemental threnody, hideous laughter, quick etude
2nd (DC 15) - blurring melody, foe lullaby, silence verse, sword madrigal, valor minuet
STATISTICS: Str 14, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 16

Skills Acrobatics +10, Appraise +8, Bluff +9, Climb +8, Diplomacy +9, Knowledge (religion) +4, Linguistics +6, Perception +8, Perform (Wind) +9, Stealth +10; Racial Modifier Knowledge (religion) +2, Linguistics +4
SQ Minor Aura +3 (Accurate Strike, Watchful Eye), Versatile Performance (Wind), Major Aura +1 (Motivate Ardor)
Gear cure potion (2), rapier, shortbow, 20 arrows, studded leather armor
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Though yagudos don't use their beaks for biting an opponent, they will use it if desperate enough to end the combat with their enemy. They all possess a bite natural attack that inflicts 1d4 points of damage on a hit. This is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the yagudo wields a manufactured weapon.
Yagudos have thick feathers that coat their body, giving them a +1 natural bonus armor.

Yagudos are very good with talking out their problems, establishing trade and setting up offerings in order to provide a type of peace and learn many different languages in order to keep that peace. They gain a +4 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and learn 2 languages each time they gain a rank in Linguistics rather than 1 language.
Yagudos being of the religious zealots gain a +2 to all Knowledge (Religion) checks and gain an additional +1 per 5 ranks in the skill.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
